description: Prompt-injection regression corpus. Each case puts a hostile payload in a project file, has a scripted model read it and then obey it with the decisions in `obey`, and states how the runtime must refuse. The payload reaches the model unmodified (repository content is untrusted input: stack-agent does not filter it); the corpus pins that obeying it gains nothing. Techniques are named after Beacon's open threat-rule corpus (asymptote-labs/agent-beacon rules/prompt-injection, rules/agent-control, rules/sensitive-edit, MIT). expect: invalid_input (blocked before anything runs, naming `refusal` when given), unknown_capability (the decision names a capability that does not exist; the work fails closed), not_completed (completion refused without evidence), not_executed (the decision is rejected; nothing runs).
